user.title: One Hungary Unofficial
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should authenticate with One Hungary.

cookie_header.title: Cookie Header
cookie_header.description: Paste the complete Cookie header from a logged-in One Hungary browser session. Example: JSESSIONID=...; CSRF_TOKEN=...; ...

cookie_file.title: Browser Profile (Cookie Export File)
cookie_file.description: Enter the path to the cookie.json file exported by tools/one_login.py. Home Assistant only reads this file, it never launches a browser itself. Example: /config/custom_components/one_hu/cookie.json

error.invalid_auth: The One Hungary session is invalid or expired. Re-run tools/one_login.py and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to One Hungary.
